builds.note: Internal ad-spy tool. Step 2.5 (macrostructure/narrative arc) deliberately skipped per SKILL.md — that layer governs public/marketing pages, and this is a sidebar+topbar shell with no hero and no scroll narrative.

shell.density: dense (nav rows space-3, card internals space-3/4)

used: staggered row entrance on data-load (28ms, cap 12)
motion.reason: No scroll narrative exists in a persistent shell.

builds.illustrations: NOT generated — ~/.ideagram/undraw/ is unpopulated. Empty states use code-native SVG in the locked palette. Stated plainly, not overclaimed.
builds.photos: none — an app shell has no photo surface; the scraped ad creatives are the real imagery
builds.stack_note: React + plain CSS, no Tailwind/shadcn detected. Registries do not apply; patterns ported by hand per component-sourcing.md Step 0.

builds.note: Scoped addition to the existing shell: trend-row detail moved from an inline 8-bar CSS expansion to a real slide-in panel with a proper chart. Step 2.5 still skipped (not a new marketing surface). Reused all locked tokens verbatim.
builds.change: row click -> slide-in panel (was: inline <tr> expansion)

behavioral_primitives_added.dialog: @base-ui/react 1.8.0 (Dialog) — caught @base-ui-components/react RC as deprecated mid-install, switched to the renamed current package
behavioral_primitives_added.chart: recharts 3.10.1 (AreaChart) — replaced hand-rolled CSS bar sparkline in the detail view per library-selection.md 'never hand-roll a chart'

used: row-spinner during in-flight detail fetch (.7s, reduced-motion -> static color break)
motion.reason: Panel transition is exactly the App-shell motion track's own category; no scroll storytelling introduced.

builds.contrast: no new pairings — every color in the panel/chart reuses an already-verified role from the Color contract (text/surface, text-muted/bg, primary/bg UI-safe)

builds.note: Extended the trend detail panel: expand-to-modal (one Dialog instance, class swap between drawer/modal, not a second dialog), a real date-range re-fetch against Google's own custom-range timeframe format, and a regional breakdown (interestByRegion, ported earlier this session but unwired until now).
builds.change: panel expand icon -> same Dialog, .panel-popup-modal variant (centered, scale-based enter). Date range -> /api/trends/daily/detail now accepts from/to, verified live against trends.google.com's 'YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD' format before building UI around it. New /api/trends/daily/regions route.
builds.contrast_catch: Initial error-text draft used --primary as a text color on --bg — only UI-safe (4.21-4.37), not text-safe, and semantically wrong anyway (primary reads as brand/active elsewhere in the shell, not error). Fixed: text/bg (already text-safe, 16.50/17.26) + an alert icon carries the severity instead of inventing a color the lock never defined.

used: modal enter/exit via scale+opacity (Base UI data-starting-style/data-ending-style), same --dur-panel token as the drawer
region bars: static width, no entrance animation added (would be decorative, not explained)
motion.reason: Expand is still a panel-family transition, not a new track. Drawer<->modal never runs both transforms simultaneously — modal state resets translateX to its own centered transform before the scale animation begins, so gate 29 (transform/opacity only, no conflicting simultaneous transforms) holds.

builds.note: Five fixes to the trend search/detail flow: debounced search (removed submit button), restyled the date-range strip to match panel-stat's card treatment, fixed a real chart bug (YAxis labels clipped by a stray negative margin fighting the axis's own width), made the advertiser count a real drill-down into matching ads via the existing /api/ads route, relocated the page-size control.
bugs_found_and_fixed: YAxis clipping: margin.left=-16 was fighting YAxis width=28, pushing axis labels off the chart's left edge entirely — not a style nitpick, the numbers were invisible
toggleExpanded/openExpanded: the expand button called setExpanded directly, bypassing the function that actually fetched regional data — regions never loaded on expand despite the code existing
builds.new_capability: Advertiser count in the panel is now clickable (only when >0) and opens a real list of matching ads (advertiser, thumbnail, landing domain, link to /ad/[id]) via /api/ads?q=<term> — the same search-everywhere query lib/market.mjs already uses to produce the count, so the number and the list are guaranteed consistent.
